maker: Xerox PARC (Alan Kay, Dan Ingalls, Adele Goldberg)
summary: The language and environment from Xerox PARC where everything is an object. Its windows, browsers and live programming shaped the graphical user interface, object-oriented programming and later languages such as Ruby and Objective-C.

events.note: Dan Ingalls writes the first Smalltalk-72 interpreter.

events.label: On the Alto
events.note: Smalltalk-72 is ported to the Xerox Alto.

events.label: Smalltalk-80
events.note: The first version made available outside Xerox.

events.label: Byte issue
events.note: A special issue of Byte magazine brings Smalltalk to a wide audience.

events.label: ANSI
events.note: ANSI Smalltalk is ratified as the standard.

note: Lives on in Pharo and Squeak, but few new projects use it.
